summary: Blocked: no detecting upstream test exists at this revision. The imported OR-versus-XOR self-distance claim contradicts the historical implementation: built_distance computes XOR popcount in both revisions. The actual normalization correction replaces inherited sqrt(Hamming distance) with Hamming distance divided by dimensions. The proposed reversal removes that override, restoring the original normalization. The fix adds no tests; tests::binary_quantized::write_and_retrieve_binary_quantized_vector checks storage of one vector, while the other binary-quantization tests check encoding and iteration, not distances. No tests were executed.
